title: Loomfall accessibility & game options
description: Schema for the options object the options screen (ux/options/) edits and the game shell persists. Persistence: merged into the existing localStorage 'loomfall.settings' object (menu.js SETTINGS_SPEC) — fov and the three volumes already exist there as fov/volumeMaster/volumeSfx/volumeMusic; this schema is the canonical UX-side shape, and the shell maps volumes.master->volumeMaster etc. on save/load. Propagation at runtime: see the architecture contract — document.documentElement dataset flags + CSS custom properties + a bubbling 'lf-options-change' CustomEvent. All properties have defaults; a valid file may be {} and consumers must fill defaults.

colorblindMode.description: Selects an alternate accent/status palette (token overrides under html[data-lf-cvd='<mode>']). Never the only channel: kit status cues already pair color with shape glyphs.

uiScale.description: Global HUD/menu scale factor. Applied as --lf-ui-scale on :root; kit sizes derive from rem so the shell sets font-size: calc(16px * var(--lf-ui-scale)) on html.

reducedMotion.description: 'system' defers to prefers-reduced-motion (base.css already collapses kit animations under the media query); 'on' forces the collapse via html[data-lf-reduced-motion='on']; 'off' forces animations on even if the OS asks otherwise.

subtitles.description: Master switch for the captions overlay (ux/captions/). When false the overlay unmounts entirely (no hidden live region churn).

fov.description: Camera field of view in degrees. Mirrors menu.js SETTINGS_SPEC fov.

volumes.description: Bus gains forwarded to AudioEngine setMasterVolume/setSfxVolume/setMusicVolume (via GameAudio.setVolumes). Stored flat in loomfall.settings as volumeMaster/volumeSfx/volumeMusic.

difficulty.description: Loomfall difficulty: gentle (reduced mob aggression/hunger drain), standard, unraveling (hard). Read by gameplay systems, not the UI layer; included here because the options screen owns the control.
